title: Why Is Palantir Stock Falling, and is it a Buying Opportunity? | PLTR Stock
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA updates Palantir after a quarter that beat expectations and raised guidance, yet left the shares down almost 3% after hours. Revenue accelerated 96% year on year to $2.3 billion, up 20% on the prior quarter, operating income reached $1.1 billion for a 47% margin comparable to Microsoft's, operating cash flow hit $1.2 billion (52% of sales), and cash topped $10.4 billion, earning roughly $500 million a year in interest. Fourth-quarter guidance is $2.65 billion revenue and $1.642 billion adjusted operating income. His concern is early slowdown signs: total contract value closed up only 6% year on year, and US commercial remaining deal value rose 79% year on year but only 4% quarter on quarter. At a 76x forward P/E he calls the stock fairly priced on that multiple but slightly undervalued on his discounted cash flow model, with fair value just over $194 against $178 into earnings and $173 after hours. He reiterates his BUY rating with low confidence, first set when the stock crashed to $106 and reiterated on 26 October, while noting his fair-value work is not final until he has digested the conference call. Nvidia's late-November results are flagged as the next big AI event. Auto-captions render Palantir as 'Palanteer' throughout, and one later passage garbles the contract-value figures.
